title: Does Your Trial Simulator Know What the Drug Does? An Intervention-Blind Test of Interventional Validity on 7,207 Registered Trials
abstract: arXiv:2611.05907v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Patient world models are increasingly proposed as simulators of clinical trials, and recent surveys rank their capabilities on a ladder from temporal prediction to counterfactual rollouts. Position on that ladder is currently assigned by reading papers rather than by measurement. We turn the counterfactual rung into a measured quantity. From 30,119 completed phase 2/3 trials with results posted to ClinicalTrials.gov we construct 9,996 audited within-trial contrasts from 7,207 trials, and we score a simulator on how much of its accuracy depends on knowing which intervention was tested. The instrument is an intervention-blind reference: the same model, trained on the same trials, with every intervention-identifying field withheld. Interventional skill is the error the full model removes relative to that reference. translated_title: 你的试验模拟器知道药物的作用吗？基于7,207项注册试验的干预盲法干预效度检验
translated_abstract: 患者世界模型正日益被提出用作临床试验的模拟器，近期的综述将其能力按从时序预测到反事实推演的能力阶梯进行排序。目前阶梯上的位置是通过阅读论文而非实际测量来确定的。我们将反事实这一层级转化为可测量的量。从30,119项已完成并将结果发布至ClinicalTrials.gov的2/3期试验中，我们从7,207项试验构建了9,996个经过审计的试验内对比，并评估模拟器的准确率在多大程度上依赖于知晓所测试的是哪种干预。该测量工具是一个干预盲参照：即同一模型、在相同的试验上训练，但隐去所有能够识别干预的字段。干预技能定义为完整模型相对于该参照所消除的误差。在时间划分上（来自655项试验的878个测试对比），一个基于注册数据训练的梯度提升模拟器消除了五分之一的……
tldr: 该论文首次将临床试验模拟器的“反事实能力”从主观论断转化为可测量的量化指标，通过构建隐去干预信息的干预盲参照模型，并基于7,207项注册试验构建的9,996个审计对比，将模拟器的干预技能定义为完整模型相对于干预盲参照所消除的误差。
en_tdlr: The paper turns the "counterfactual rung" of clinical trial simulator capability from a subjective claim into a measured quantity, introducing an intervention-blind reference model to score interventional skill as the error the full model removes, validated on 9,996 audited within-trial contrasts from 7,207 registered trials.
